subject: Principles of Microeconomics
topic: Price Elasticity of Demand and Market Welfare
syllabus_context: Unit III: Elasticity and Market Welfare. Price elasticity of demand (Ed), midpoint formula, elastic vs. inelastic demand curves, total revenue test, income and cross-price elasticity, consumer and producer surplus, deadweight loss resulting from price controls.
declared_learning_objective: Calculate the price elasticity of demand using the midpoint method, interpret whether demand is price-elastic, inelastic, or unit-elastic, explain the relationship between elasticity and total revenue, and evaluate how price distortions create deadweight loss.

provenance.source: MIT OpenCourseWare 14.01 (Principles of Microeconomics, Prof. Jonathan Gruber)

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Chalkboard graphs of supply and demand curves described verbally with axis points.
